newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound almost stable against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound almost stable against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound again remained almost unchanged against the dollar on Wednesday in a balanced private sector market, bankers said.
"The market is stable," said one banker.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3890 and 3.3910 bid and 3.3910 and 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.3905 bid and 3.3925 offered compared to 3.39075 bid and 3.392625 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388722 pounds buy and 3.393828 pounds sell.
